svg.text: bottom and the back; 2 mm sheet, bent on a press brake.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sides by folded tabs with two 4 mm rivets each.

svg.text: thumb screws. 25 mm air gap at the front, sides and top.
